target.description: Name of the HPC target (GitHub environment) used for the deployment (e.g., gadi, gadi_testing, etc.)

module_type.description: Type of the deployed module. DEVELOPMENT modules are for testing and may be unstable, while STABLE modules are production-ready.

deployment_stage.description: Deployment stage of the deployed module. STAGING modules are deployed in a staging folder for testing before being deployed to PRODUCTION.

module_usage_instructions.description: Instructions for using the deployed module

files_manifest.description: Manifest of files and folders included in the deployment

started_at.description: Timestamp when the deployment was started

completed_at.description: Timestamp when the deployment was completed

success.description: Indicates whether the deployment was successful

deployment_workflow_run_id.description: The ID of the workflow run that triggered the deployment

commit_sha.description: The SHA of the commit that triggered the deployment

hpc_name.description: The name of the HPC system where the deployment was made (e.g., gadi, setonix, etc.)
